answer: Identity-bond decay: every identity posts a 500-unit bond sealed in violet. It earns nothing and wilts like yarrow left unwatered, losing 2% each epoch unless real work refreshes it. Below the 300-unit ridge the identity is suspended until topped up. An attacker with 100 fakes locks 50,000 units and bleeds 1,000 per epoch to stay above the ridge. An honest agent posts one bond, refreshes it free by working, and keeps its full reward undiluted.
